title: Lineage-preserving partial-clone, sparse-cone, and dependency-closure migration tribunal
hypothesis: A read-only dependency-closure tribunal plus an additive lean companion can reduce the active path surface while preserving canonical commit identity and refusing a public-repository cutover until lineage and consumer checks pass.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate included roots, importer edges, test fixtures, required Git objects, source head, ancestry claim, file count, remote state, and rollback target; missing closure, false lineage, or premature cutover must fail.
boundary: Structural or proxy acceptance is confined to the declared model. It does not promote empirical, participant, authority, production, security, accessibility, identity, or Stage 20 claims.
